svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Debug Event 与 Audit Log 独立时序

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Debug Event 与 Audit Log 独立时序
Debug Event：Actor 到无界 SQL queue
[debug mode output / failure / ack / next relation]
validate and truncate each debug field
assign time UUID; sync partition check / possible DDL
return to Actor-thread caller after enqueue
output path then calls chainActor.tell / TbMsg callback / route
direct callback usually runs inline here
fail all pack futures, no retry
direct callback usually logs inline here
Only the JDBC batch after queue.add is asynchronous and best-effort.
Validation and partition DDL run on the Actor call path before enqueue.
directExecutor never posts to the Actor mailbox.
If already complete when registered, callback runs on the registering thread;
otherwise it usually runs inline on the SQL queue completion thread.
Later batch failure does not roll back or replay the Rule Engine message.
Audit Log：业务动作后的独立 JPA 事务
BaseController helpers skip EntityAction and Audit for SYS_ADMIN.
request may fail after entity was saved
The entity may already be saved while the HTTP request still fails.
immediate failed Future; no task submitted
return; failed Future is commonly ignored
Future is returned and commonly ignored
Shared with Relation, Attributes, EntityView and other JPA work.
No Audit-specific capacity, backpressure or failure counter is guaranteed.
log error/warning; no retry or DB rollback
fail Audit Future; DB stays committed
This async failure is not delivered synchronously to HTTP.
The async DB failure normally remains in the ignored Future
and does not roll back the already completed business operation.
request may fail after entity was saved
The entity may already be saved while the HTTP request still fails.
Event batch, audit row, business entity transaction,
Rule Engine message and external sink never form one transaction.
GET/POST with entity, time, filter and page
drop event/debug partitions with positive cutoff
drop audit partitions with partitionEnd < cutoff
cleanup local event caches for positive cutoffs
Event TTL zero skips that event category inside JpaBaseEventDao.
A non-owner node cleans local partition caches instead of just returning.
Deletion is by whole partition, not row timestamp.
Actual retention extends by partition and scheduler intervals.
Pending events may be lost or their futures may not complete.
Dummy implementation returns empty pages / null writes
[Elasticsearch task / HTTP unavailable after task accepted]
warning/error only; PostgreSQL audit row remains
Audit Future fails; PostgreSQL row remains
